description: Check whether a 0x address on Ink is a smart contract or a plain wallet: bytecode size, and whether it is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy and which implementation it points to. Use before sending funds or approving a spender; for a fuller risk verdict use check_counterparty. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xF1815bd50389c46847f0Bda824eC8da914045D14. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: ink_is_contract
title: Ink contract check
